info.title: Gridex Website and Partner Integration API
info.description: Canonical V1 contract publication and website application API. OPS supplies complete versioned contract prices, fees, VAT and presentation rules. Tenant backends resolve public energy areas and external market prices; OPS never supplies tenant-facing Nord Pool prices.

get.summary: Verify the API key tenant context
get.description: Scope: integration_context.read. The API key is authoritative; company_id is never accepted as a tenant selector.
Scope: website_contracts.read. Supports ETag/If-None-Match and returns 304. diagnostics=1 is deprecated; use the diagnostics endpoint. Sunset: 2026-10-31.

parameters.name: customer_type
parameters.description: private or business. company is deprecated and normalized to business.

X-Gridex-Contract-Version.description: Version of the machine-readable public contract representation. Changes invalidate ETag.

get.description: Scope: website_contracts.diagnostics. Uses the same canonical publication graph and readiness sources as the normal feed. The normal data field remains an array.

parameters.name: customer_type
parameters.description: private or business. company is deprecated and normalized to business.

get.summary: List contracts published to the api channel
get.description: Scope: api_contracts.read. This endpoint is independent of the website channel and has its own tenant+channel publication revision.

parameters.name: customer_type
parameters.description: private or business. company is deprecated and normalized to business.

304.description: API publication revision has not changed

post.summary: Create a tenant-bound canonical quote for one published offer and one SE area
post.description: Scope: website_quotes.write. Freezes the exact published product/version, selected SE-area price, fees, VAT, assumptions, consumption and requested start date. One quote is consumed by at most one canonical customer application.

404.description: Published offer not found for tenant

422.description: Area price or quote input cannot be used

post.summary: Validate a canonical quote before customer application
post.description: Scope: website_quotes.validate. Verifies tenant, offer, customer type, SE area, grid area, postal code, annual consumption and requested start date. A quote already consumed by another application is rejected.

409.description: Quote already consumed or binding mismatch

422.description: Quote expired or no longer valid

post.summary: Create a customer application bound to a published offer
post.description: Scope: website_applications.write. Idempotency-Key is required. One canonical application binds one tenant customer identity, one site and one selected published offer. quote_reference is recommended and validated/consumed when present; legacy omission remains temporarily backwards compatible. OPS creates or reuses the canonical customer/customer_number, freezes the selected SE-area price, creates the site/contract/billing snapshot, queues customer communication and starts data-request or supplier-switch automation when readiness allows.

Gridex sends signed HMAC-SHA256 requests. Verify x-gridex-timestamp and x-gridex-signature over `${timestamp}.${rawBody}`, reject stale timestamps, and deduplicate by x-gridex-event-id / x-gridex-delivery-id. Return any 2xx on success. Failed attempts use the configured retry/dead-letter pipeline.

post.summary: Resolve canonical SE area, grid area and grid owner before quote and application
post.description: Scope: website_energy_area.resolve. Uses the tenant-scoped OPS resolver. The unauthenticated legacy GET /api/public/energy-area remains removed.

200.description: Resolution completed or requires a next action

get.summary: Read supplier-switch status for an application
get.description: Scope: website_switch_status.read. application_number is resolved strictly inside the API key tenant. Internal company, application and switch UUIDs are not exposed.

tenant_reference.description: Stable opaque tenant identity. It is not the internal company UUID.

CustomerType.description: Canonical values. company is temporarily accepted as a deprecated alias for business until 2026-10-31.

fixed_price.description: Compatibility value only when all SE-area prices are equal; otherwise null.

summary_components.description: Komponenter som får ingå som separata rader i en fullständig prissammanställning. Dolda komponenter finns fortfarande i calculation_components och totalsumman.

area_pricing.description: Canonical area-price matrix for the same offer.

fixed_price_ore_per_kwh.description: Compatibility scalar. Returned only when every available SE area has the same fixed price; otherwise null. Use area_pricing.

monthly_fee_sek.description: Always returned when applicable; visibility never removes it from API calculation data.

invoice_fee_sek.description: Always returned when applicable; visibility never removes it from API calculation data.

area_pricing.description: SE1-SE4 prices belonging to this one canonical product/version. They are not separate offers.

PublicContract.description: Complete machine-readable calculation contract. Pricing fields and calculation_components include hidden charges. display_components is the presentation-only subset.

customer_type.description: company is a deprecated alias for business.

quote_reference.description: Recommended canonical quote reference. Legacy clients may omit it temporarily; OPS then freezes the exact published version and selected area directly.

price_area.description: Resolved by the tenant. OPS verifies validity and offer eligibility.

external_customer_reference.description: Alias for external_customer_id. Preserved while OPS assigns or reuses the canonical customer_number.

WebsiteVisibilityMode.description: Presentation only. Hidden components remain available to the tenant calculation engine.

CalculationInclusion.description: Whether the component participates in the calculation. Independent of website visibility.

customer_type.description: company is a deprecated alias for business.

Forbidden.description: Scope missing or tenant access denied

Conflict.description: Expired, consumed or mismatched quote/idempotency state
